BETA v1.6.2 (27 July 2019) |previous_update = [[BETA v1.5]] |next_update = [[BETA v1.7]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''BETA v1.6''' was the seventh update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 19th of July 2019. It added the [[Rocketeer|Rocketer]] tower, emotes and three new maps. As with most updates before the [[Solar Eclipse Event]], there was no official name for updates. As a result, the name '''BETA v1.6''' has been retroactively applied to this update. This version encompassed seven updates, the main BETA v1.6.0 update (released 19 July 2019) and six updates, the BETA v1.6.0a update (released 19 July 2019), the BETA v1.6.0b update (released 19 July 2019), the BETA v1.6.0c update (released 19 July 2019), the BETA v1.6.0d update (released 20 July 2019), the BETA v1.6.1 update (released 22 July 2019) and the BETA v1.6.2 update (released 27 July 2019). ==Additions== ===Towers=== In '''BETA v1.6.0a''': *[[Rocketeer|Rocketer]] ===Enemies=== In '''BETA v1.6.2''': *[[Mystery Summoner|Mystery Boss]] ===Maps=== *[[Moon Base]] *[[Deserted Village]] In '''BETA v1.6.0d''': *[[Tropical Isles]] :In '''BETA v1.6.1''': *[[Mount Amillion]] ===Emotes=== *[[Classic Party]] *[[Monster Mash]] *[[Dab]] *[[Flex (Emote)|Flex]] *[[Russian]] *[[Tpose]] *[[Poisoned]] *[[Orange Justice]] *[[Revenge]] *[[Bumper Kart]] (Exclusive) :In '''BETA v1.6.0d''': *[[Gang Dance]] ===Miscellaneous=== *Datastore system *New [[Codes|code]]: LONGWAIT **Gives {{Coins|100}}, {{Exp|50}} and [[Russian]] :In '''BETA v1.6.1''': *New ban system *[[Badges|Level Badges]] ==Changes & Bugfixes== *[[Militant|John]] now purchasable in the store for {{Coins|1,000}}, as the code J0HNRBX expired. *[[Normal]] animation changed. *[[Speedy]] animation changed. *[[Slow]] animation changed. *[[Mystery]] animation changed. *[[Super Mystery|Mystery 2]] animation changed. *Fixed duo and trio not having a boosted wave bonus compared to quad, now duo gives {{Money|60}} per wave while trio gives {{Money|50}} per wave. In '''BETA v1.6.0a''': *Fixed some data issues. In '''BETA v1.6.0b''': *[[Rocketeer]] nerfed. **Unlock cost decreased from {{Coins|2,650}} to {{Coins|2,000}}. **Placement limit decreased from 8 to 4. *[[Orange Justice]] cost decreased from {{Robux|1,000,000,000}} to {{Robux|100}}. In '''BETA v1.6.0c''': *[[Rocketeer]] unlock cost increased from {{Coins|2,000}} to {{Coins|2,650}}. :In '''BETA v1.6.1''': *[[Orange Justice]] music changed. *[[Demoman]] nerfed. **'''Level 5''' ***Direct damage decreased from +25 to +18. ***Splash damage decreased from +12 to +9. *[[Rocketeer|Rocketer]] nerfed. **Unlock cost increased from {{Coins|2,000}} to {{Coins|2,650}}. **Statistical changes: ***'''Level 1''' ****Upgrade price increased from {{Money|200}} to {{Money|500}}. ***'''Level 2''' ****Upgrade price increased from {{Money|600}} to {{Money|1,200}}. ***'''Level 3''' ****Upgrade price increased from {{Money|2,600}} to {{Money|3,000}}. ***'''Level 4''' ****Upgrade price increased from {{Money|6,200}} to {{Money|7,200}}. ***'''Level 5''' ****Upgrade price increased from {{Money|10,000}} to {{Money|15,000}}. :In '''BETA v1.6.2''': *[[Poisoned]] music changed. *[[Russian]] now purchasable in the store for {{Coins|650}}, as the code LONGWAIT expired. *[[Necromancer (Legacy Enemy)|Necromancer]] spawning animation changed. *Fixed Level 3 [[Crook Boss]]'s range not increasing. *Changed triumph and lost screens. *Fixed stats resetting. ==Official Update Log== ''NOTE: Not everything here will be accurate as this is transcribed from the game's description.
